Exam authority: part A states the issuer, the 2026 handbook, the 50-question knowledge test and its 80 percent (40 of 50) passing standard from physical page 5; the time limit is unknown.
VERIFY list:
- WI-TEST-A-TIME — knowledge-test time limit not printed in the handbook, only an expected duration (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- WI-TEST-D-VEHICLE — what happens on the road test when the examiner finds the car unsafe (owner HallucinationAuditor).
- WI-TEST-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- WI-TEST-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: the online test fee and age range, service center hours and the DMV web pages for practice and road test scheduling (for example sec01-F12, sec01-F14, sec01-F17) can change and must be refreshed from the Wisconsin DMV website.
